speaker: judith_shakespeare
text: On the step, as I said they would be. They can be real out here. They do not have to come in to prove it.

speaker: joan_shakespeare
text: I have the three. The beans have started to believe me. Go, while the light is still a path and not a story.

speaker: anne_shakespeare
text: The knife is in the belt. I have seen it. I am not asking a second time.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Then the step is done. We are out. The three are yours, Joan, as we said.
